attributes.name: SourceWeights
attributes.helptext: Describes the mapping between the weight and the animation sources

attributes.name: SourceWeightDistributionRange
attributes.helptext: This is used to keep the same range for linear distribution of weights

attributes.name: SourceWeightDistribution
attributes.helptext: Defines how the input to the weight pin blends between the input nodes

attributes.name: WrapWeights
attributes.helptext: Interpolate across the last animation back to the first one

attributes.name: TimeStretchMode
attributes.helptext: Changes the time stretching functionality of this node.

attributes.name: SphericallyInterpolateTrajectoryPosition
attributes.helptext: Spherically interpolate between the two trajectory translation inputs. The trajectory orientation is always spherically interpolated.

attributes.name: AlwaysBlendTrajectoryAndTransforms
attributes.helptext: Always blend evaluates the trajectory delta and transform buffers for the two active sources even if it is completely weighted to one source. This option may improve performance if the weight usually falls somewhere between source weights but does not precisely fall on a source weight. When this option is disabled it may improve performance if the weight usually falls precisely on a source weight.

attributes.name: AlwaysCombineSampledEvents
attributes.helptext: Always blend evaluate the events buffers for the two active sources even if it is completely weighted to one source. This option may improve performance if the weight usually falls somewhere between source weights but does not precisely fall on a source weight. When this option is disabled it may improve performance if the weight usually falls precisely on a source weight.

attributes.name: Loop
attributes.helptext: Sets whether the result of this node loops when it reaches the end of it's sequence.

attributes.name: StartEventIndex
attributes.helptext: The sync event tracks from the inputs are combined here. This is the index of the event on the new synctrack from which to start playback.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendPassThrough
attributes.helptext: When set, all events are copied straight to output.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendIgnoreEventOrder
attributes.helptext: Ignoring the order of events when blending means that events in the source tracks will be combined even if they have duration events in different orders.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendSameUserData
attributes.helptext: Duration events will only be blended together when they share the same user data.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendOnOverlap
attributes.helptext: When set, if not overlapping simply copy into the result.

attributes.name: DurationEventBlendWithinRange
attributes.helptext: When set, blend or reject only events that are within a specified event range of each other, otherwise put straight into the result.
